cic_ids2017.retrieval: Follow the official page to obtain MachineLearningCSV.zip; record a reviewed SHA-256 before using the downloader.
cic_ids2017.capture_boundaries: 2017-07-03 through 2017-07-07; source CSV/day grouping is required.
cic_ids2017.license_and_citation: Use is governed by the official page; cite Sharafaldin, Lashkari, and Ghorbani (ICISSP 2018).
cic_ids2017.expected_layout: One or more CICFlowMeter CSV files with Label and preferably Timestamp columns.

cse_cic_ids2018.retrieval: The official page documents anonymous AWS S3 access. Inventory objects first and record a reviewed checksum for every selected CSV; do not sync unbounded data through AegisFlow.
cse_cic_ids2018.capture_boundaries: Daily captures from 2018-02-14 through 2018-03-02; preserve source-file/day groups.
cse_cic_ids2018.license_and_citation: Redistribution requires citation and a link to the official UNB page.
cse_cic_ids2018.expected_layout: One or more CICFlowMeter-V3 CSV files with Label and Timestamp columns.

hikari2021.retrieval: Download only ALLFLOWMETER_HIKARI2021.csv.zip from the official Zenodo record; verify the published MD5 and record a locally reviewed SHA-256 before extraction.
hikari2021.capture_boundaries: HIKARI-2021 encrypted synthetic attack and real benign/background flow collection; preserve source archive and traffic_category labels.
hikari2021.license_and_citation: CC BY 4.0. Cite Ferriyan, Thamrin, Takeda, and Murai and DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6463389.
hikari2021.expected_layout: ALLFLOWMETER_HIKARI2021.csv with traffic_category, Label, origin/responder endpoints, duration, directional packet/payload/header totals, flag counts, and IAT statistics.

iot23_zeek.retrieval: Select reviewed IndividualScenarios conn.log.labeled files from the official CTU repository; record a SHA-256 for each exact object and preserve capture-file groups.
iot23_zeek.capture_boundaries: Twenty malicious and three real-IoT benign scenarios collected by Stratosphere Laboratory; every selected scenario remains a distinct source group.
iot23_zeek.license_and_citation: CC BY 2.0. Cite Parmisano, Garcia, and Erquiaga and the official IoT-23 dataset page.
iot23_zeek.expected_layout: Zeek conn.log.labeled with #fields metadata, timestamps, endpoints, protocol, ports, directional packet/IP-byte totals, label, and detailed-label.

unsw_nb15.retrieval: Use the official UNSW links for the published CSV partitions; record SHA-256 locally before import.
unsw_nb15.capture_boundaries: Preserve the official training/testing partition or original source-file grouping.
unsw_nb15.license_and_citation: Academic use is granted on the official page; commercial use requires author agreement and the named papers must be cited.
unsw_nb15.expected_layout: UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv, UNSW_NB15_testing-set.csv, or the four original CSV files with attack_cat and label.

nfstream_csv.retrieval: User-provided local flow CSV only; provide a label column and retain its local checksum manifest.
nfstream_csv.capture_boundaries: Provide a source-file, capture-day, or explicit group column.
nfstream_csv.license_and_citation: User is responsible for authorization and provenance.
nfstream_csv.expected_layout: Canonical AegisFlow columns or NFStream bidirectional/src2dst/dst2src column names.

synthetic_smoke.retrieval: Generated locally by training.cli.train_smoke with seed 431.
synthetic_smoke.expected_layout: Generated in memory; no dataset file is committed.
